he sole discretion of the board of directors of the Company (the “Board”) at any time on or before December 31, 2026, a reverse stock split of the Company’s Common Stock at a ratio ranging from 1-for-15 to 1-for-35 (or any number in between), with the specific ratio and timing to be determined by the Board.
